name: Serving God
overview: Serving God is portrayed in Scripture as a wholehearted commitment to obeying His commandments, cleaving to Him, and loving Him with all one's heart and soul, as emphasized in Deuteronomy 13:4 and Joshua 22:5. True service involves exclusive devotion, for one cannot serve both God and worldly masters, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 6:24. Christ exemplifies the nature of service by ministering selflessly and giving His life as a ransom, calling His followers to follow His example and promising honor from the Father to those who serve Him faithfully, as seen in Mark 10:45 and John 12:26. This call to serve includes individuals in all life stages, including single persons, who are equally called to this wholehearted dedication.
